messages:
Jordan (AE): Quick presales ask from NordicBank — they want assurance that for the Hosted POC EU data will not leave EU and a line item for egress charges if we do replication. Also want cert details (can they rotate certs) and a short checklist for their SecOps.
Priya (Solutions): They're on Hosted for POC, might move to Dedicated. Short answers: main inference and storage stay in chosen EU region; Hosted doesn't support BYO client mTLS today; Dedicated does. Need infra/legal to confirm telemetry and analytics paths.
Omar (Infra): Confirmed: API fronted at api.eu.redwood.ai, primary processing in eu-west-1/eu-central-1 depending on tenant. Client TLS terminates at the regional edge; service-to-service mTLS in backend. Telemetry/metrics normally land in our EU metrics cluster, but some aggregated analytics may be processed in a central plane in us-central. We can opt for EU-only metrics for this customer with ~2-4 week lead and extra cost. DNS/health checks may use global resolvers but carry no customer payloads.
Helena (Customer Sec): NordicBank requires a one-page attestation of sub-processors and geo-locations. Also wants cert rotation cadence and ability to reject non-EU sub-processor use.
Hana (Legal): We can offer a Residency Addendum: warrant EU-only hosting for inference payloads and use of EU-resident sub-processor clusters where available, enumerate exceptions (DNS, global auth, emergency failover), and require a written change request for any cross-border egress. I'll draft an addendum and clause for change-order approval. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Marco (Sales Ops): Pricing note: EU-only metrics replication and hard geofencing is an add-on. Ballpark: onboarding fee ~€3.5k, replication/egress ~€0.02/GB. Dedicated pin = capacity premium ~10-15%. I'll validate with finance and attach numbers.
Priya (Solutions): Can we produce a one-page checklist runbook for SecOps? Omar, quick checklist please.
Omar (Infra): Runbook (copy/paste):
1) Sign Residency Addendum
2) Enable EU-region tenant pin (provision ~4h)
3) Toggle EU-only metrics replication (2–4 weeks if not pre-provisioned)
4) Confirm endpoints: api.eu.redwood.ai + metrics.eu.redwood.ai
5) Whitelist provided EU egress CIDRs
6) Optional: migrate to Dedicated for BYO mTLS
7) Acceptance test & sign-off
Will also export sub-processor list with region flags and drop here.
Jordan (AE): Perfect. I'll send the runbook to NordicBank and set expectations for Legal/Quote/Subproc list. 
region-bot: Regional scan: eu-west-1 pass, no known outbound leaks. :white_check_mark:
Hana (Legal): Draft Residency Addendum will be in this thread EOD tomorrow.
Marco (Sales Ops): I'll attach provisional quote after finance confirm.
Priya (Solutions): Next steps: Jordan send runbook; Hana draft addendum; Omar drop subproc export; Marco attach quote.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all — sending now. :thumbsup:
